build_task_constellation: build a PHYRE task that creates a constellation of static balls and a dynamic ball
create_static_balls: create static ball objects positioned as a star constellation pattern in the scene
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object placed at the center bottom of the scene
update_task_touching: update the task to require the dynamic ball touching the bottom wall
define_task_decorator: define a PHYRE task using the creator_lib define_task decorator to register build_task
